data.name: Venipuncture / Blood Draw

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Sample Collection
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for laboratory analysis, including clinical safety labs, exploratory biomarkers, and genetics samples

data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Complete Physical Exam
data.description: Full physical examination including heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. Excludes pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Exam
data.description: Targeted physical evaluation based on participant status and standard of care, including examination of heart, lungs, abdomen, neurological system, thyroid, and visual examination of the skin. Includes periodic TB risk factor assessment.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature after participant has been sitting for at least 5 minutes.

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads

data.label: 12-Lead ECG
data.description: Single, local 12-lead ECG collected before blood samples for laboratory testing. May be repeated at investigator's discretion at any visit.

data.name: Chest X-Ray

code.decode: Radiologic examination, chest; 2 views

data.label: Chest X-Ray (PA and Lateral)
data.description: Posterior-anterior and if needed lateral view chest x-ray performed locally. Required if skin TB test, QuantiFERON-TB Gold test, or T-SPOT.TB is positive or other indications of TB are present. Interpreted and reported by a radiologist or pulmonologist.

data.name: Chest CT Scan

code.decode: Computed tomography, thorax; without contrast material

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Computed tomography scan of the chest, used as an alternative to chest x-ray for TB evaluation if performed within the same time window.

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study

data.label: DXA Scan (Whole Body)
data.description: Whole body DXA scan for body composition assessment. Participants must fast for at least 8 hours without eating or drinking (except water) before each scan, with no water within 2 hours before the scan.

data.name: Colonoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Colonoscopy, flexible; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Colonoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Colonoscopy (preferred over sigmoidoscopy) with biopsy collection for efficacy assessment of ulcerative colitis disease activity. Biopsies obtained for histological analysis and exploratory biomarker analysis (colon/rectum tissue). A second colonoscopy is allowed if inadequate preparation or equipment issues.

data.name: Sigmoidoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Sigmoidoscopy, flexible; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Sigmoidoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Flexible sigmoidoscopy with biopsy as an alternative to colonoscopy. Biopsies obtained for histological analysis and exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Intravenous Infusion of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Chemotherapy administration, intravenous infusion technique; up to 1 hour

data.label: IV Infusion (Mirikizumab)
data.description: Intravenous infusion of mirikizumab 300 mg at Weeks 0, 4, and 8 during induction. Administered only by authorized study personnel at a maximum rate of 10 mg/min by IV infusion over no less than 30 minutes.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection (Mirikizumab)
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of mirikizumab 200 mg Q4W starting at Week 12 during maintenance, given as 2 consecutive injections of 100 mg each using a prefilled syringe. Initial administration onsite; subsequent doses may be self-administered at home.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Tirzepatide

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection (Tirzepatide)
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of tirzepatide administered weekly (QW) with dose escalation from 2.5 mg up to 15 mg. Initial administration onsite with training; subsequent doses may be self-administered at home by participant or caregiver.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Placebo

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: SC Injection (Placebo to match tirzepatide)
data.description: Subcutaneous injection of placebo to match tirzepatide, administered weekly (QW). Initial administration onsite; subsequent doses may be self-administered at home.

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Test

code.decode: Calprotectin, fecal

data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool sample collection for fecal calprotectin measurement as a biomarker for UC disease activity at multiple time points.

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool sample collection for culture testing. Additional local stool testing (e.g., for ova and parasites) allowed at investigator's discretion.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Biomarkers (Blood)
data.description: Collection of blood samples for exploratory biomarker analysis at multiple time points.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Collection

code.decode: Biospecimen Collection

data.label: Exploratory Biomarkers (Stool Supernatant)
data.description: Collection of stool supernatant samples for exploratory biomarker analysis at multiple time points.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Colon/Rectum Tissue Collection

code.decode: Level IV - Surgical pathology, gross and microscopic examination

data.label: Exploratory Biomarkers (Colon/Rectum Tissue)
data.description: Collection of colonic/rectal biopsy tissue for exploratory biomarker analysis, obtained during colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy.

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for genetic analysis. Sample can be obtained at or after Visit 2.

data.name: Pregnancy Testing

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); qualitative

data.label: Pregnancy Test
data.description: Pregnancy testing as part of safety assessments per protocol Section 8.2.6.

data.name: Suicidal Ideation and Behavior Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Administration of patient-focused health risk assessment instrument

data.label: C-SSRS Assessment
data.description: Clinician-administered Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) assessment. Screening/Baseline (Category Version) at Visit 1; Since Last Assessed (Category Version) at subsequent visits.

data.name: Depression Monitoring

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: QIDS-SR16 Assessment
data.description: Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology – Self-Report 16 items (QIDS-SR16) administered electronically for depression monitoring.

data.name: Height Measurement

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: Height
data.description: Measurement of participant height per standardized protocol in Section 10.9.

data.name: Weight Measurement

code.decode: Monitoring

data.label: Body Weight
data.description: Measurement of participant body weight per standardized protocol in Section 10.9.

data.name: Waist Circumference Measurement

code.decode: Monitoring

data.label: Waist Circumference
data.description: Measurement of waist circumference per standardized protocol in Section 10.9.

data.name: Tuberculosis Skin Test / QuantiFERON-TB Gold / T-SPOT.TB

code.decode: Tuberculosis test, cell mediated immunity antigen response measurement

data.label: TB Testing
data.description: Assessment for tuberculosis using skin TB test, QuantiFERON-TB Gold test, or T-SPOT.TB. Positive results trigger chest x-ray requirement.

data.name: Extraintestinal Manifestations Assessment

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: EIM Assessment
data.description: Assessment of extraintestinal manifestations (EIMs) of ulcerative colitis at screening and Week 52.

data.name: Modified Mayo Score Review

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: mMS Review
data.description: Clinician-administered electronic review of the modified Mayo Score (mMS) for assessment of ulcerative colitis disease activity per Section 8.1.1.1.

data.name: Clinical Safety Laboratory Tests

code.decode: Comprehensive metabolic panel

data.label: Clinical Lab Tests
data.description: Clinical safety laboratory tests including standard hematology, chemistry, and other panels per Appendix 2. Includes laboratory samples at time of systemic hypersensitivity events and nutritional monitoring panel in case of suspected malnutrition.

data.name: C-Reactive Protein Measurement

code.decode: C-reactive protein

data.label: CRP
data.description: Blood sample collection and measurement of C-reactive protein (CRP) as a biomarker at Weeks 4, 12, 24, and 52.

data.name: Injection Training - Tirzepatide SC

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: Tirzepatide Injection Training
data.description: Training of participants or caregivers on self-administration of tirzepatide subcutaneous injection. Performed at Visit 2 and repeated as needed.

data.name: Injection Training - Mirikizumab SC

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: Mirikizumab Injection Training
data.description: Training of participants or caregivers on self-administration of mirikizumab subcutaneous injection. Performed at Visit 5 (Week 12) and repeated as needed.

data.name: Lifestyle Counseling

code.decode: Assessment

data.label: Diet, Exercise, and Lifestyle Counseling
data.description: Counseling on diet, exercise, and lifestyle goals per Sections 5.3.1 and 5.3.2, conducted at each visit during induction and maintenance periods.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS (Mirikizumab SC)
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous administration of mirikizumab 100 mg during maintenance phase. Two consecutive injections of 100 mg each administered Q4W.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS (Tirzepatide SC)
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous administration of tirzepatide at escalating weekly doses (2.5 mg, 5 mg, 7.5 mg, 10 mg, 12.5 mg, 15 mg). Used for both onsite and at-home self-administration.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS (Placebo to match tirzepatide)
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous administration of placebo to match tirzepatide, administered weekly.

data.name: IV Infusion System
data.label: IV Infusion (Mirikizumab)
data.description: Intravenous infusion system for administration of mirikizumab 300 mg during induction at a maximum rate of 10 mg/min over no less than 30 minutes.

data.name: 12-Lead ECG Device
data.label: ECG Machine (Local)
data.description: Local 12-lead electrocardiogram device used for cardiac safety monitoring at screening and as needed throughout the study.

data.name: DXA Scanner
data.label: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Scanner
data.description: Whole body DXA scanner used for body composition assessment at baseline and follow-up visits.

data.name: Electronic Diary (eDiary)
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary used by participants to record daily symptom data including bowel movement urgency (Urgency NRS) and other patient-reported outcomes required for mMS assessment and colonoscopy scheduling compliance.

data.name: Interactive Web-Response System (IWRS)
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web-response system used for registering visits, dispensing study intervention, and managing randomization.

data.name: QuantiFERON-TB Gold Test
data.label: QuantiFERON-TB Gold
data.description: In vitro diagnostic device for detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection used for TB screening.

data.name: T-SPOT.TB Test
data.label: T-SPOT.TB
data.description: In vitro diagnostic device for detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection used as an alternative TB screening test.

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Blood Samples
data.description: Blood samples collected for exploratory biomarker analysis are stored (retained) per protocol Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention). Samples collected at multiple time points during the study.

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Samples
data.description: Stool supernatant samples collected for exploratory biomarker analysis are stored (retained) per protocol Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention).

data.name: Stored Exploratory Biomarker Colon/Rectum Tissue Samples
data.description: Colonic/rectal biopsy tissue samples obtained during colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy are stored (retained) for exploratory biomarker analysis per protocol Section 10.1.12 (Sample Retention).

data.name: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collected for genetic analysis per Appendix 13 (Genetics). Sample can be obtained at or after Visit 2. Retained for genetic/genomic research.
